Allternit PDF Editor portable mode

While this file sits next to pdfcraft.exe, Allternit PDF Editor keeps its settings, log files, crash-recovery
autosaves and new digital IDs in the AllternitPdfData folder beside it, and writes nothing to
%APPDATA% or %LOCALAPPDATA%. Copy the whole folder to move Allternit PDF Editor with its settings.

Delete this file to use the normal per-user folders (%APPDATA%\Allternit PDF Editor and
%LOCALAPPDATA%\Allternit PDF Editor) instead. If AllternitPdfData can't be written (for example on
a read-only drive), Allternit PDF Editor says so and uses the per-user folders instead.
